shared.description: Forged by the Avatars in ages long past. Now available for DragonFable's anniversary! Allows element selection. Visit the Black Market Moglin to upgrade this weapon. This item requires a Dragon Amulet to use.
shared.notes:
Weapons are animated; weapons have unique animations for some available elements:
  • In all appearances, the Water Orb's water runs, the Energy Orb crackles with energy, and the Darkness Orb's purple markings rise continuously.
  • In Nature appearance, rocks float and spin near the blade continuously.
  • In Fire appearance, flames flicker across the blade continuously.
  • In Energy appearance, the blade crackles with energy periodically.
Click on the weapon's orb to display and change between its available elements, or click on the grip or pommel to cycle through its available elements; this will also change its appearance.

name: Ancient Frost Moglin Scepter
description: This scepter was created by Frost Moglins in a past age. Well, not this one specifically. This is just a replica! (Cosmetic)

name: Ancient Frost Moglin Sword
description: This sword was created by Frost Moglins to confront an ancient threat. Well, not this one specifically. This is just a replica! (Cosmetic)

name: Antique Blade of Chaos
description: Contained within this weapon is a strange power, threatening to escape and envelop all with its tendrils... Thankfully it's dormant. For now. (Cosmetic)

name: Antique DragonLord's Rite
description: A legendary blade wielded by DragonLords of the past, this storied weapon has served alongside dragons and DragonLords in defense of Lore. And now it's yours. (Cosmetic)
notes: *Despite not being tagged as DA Required, this weapon does require a Dragon Amulet to obtain.

name: Antique Knight Dagger
description: Forged in an era long past, this staff is empowered by the spirit of a noble dravir. Did humans and dravir work together in the past? On-demand, increases your STR/DEX/INT by 10 x the number of Antique Knight items equipped.

weaponSpecial.trigger: Activate your weapon's special!
weaponSpecial.effect: Applies 'Knight's Boon' (+10X STR/DEX/INT) to player for 10 turns inclusive; 2 hits of 75% Light damage, amounting to 150% damage.

notes:
Description erroneously copy from Antique Knight Staff, rather than stating its a dagger.
X is equal to the number of Antique Knights items equipped; X is increased by 1 if Antique Knight Helm and/or Antique Knight Cloak are equipped, capped at 3 (+30 STR/DEX/INT).
Description erroneously copy from Antique Knight Staff, rather than stating its a dagger.

*Formula for temporary weapon damage:
  • quote:
Average damage formula: SQRT(Level)*10, rounded down; min/max damage values are generated randomly by subtracting/adding a value between 1 and 4 inclusive.
Weapon's On-Hit special is only exclusive to its Level 90 version.
Blade of Destiny's On-Hit special is able to to activate alongside its On-Demand special.
Weapons are animated; the Elemental Spirit part of the blade glows periodically.
The following changes were implemented to Blade of Destiny (50-80) on January 28th, 2019:
  • Special's damage was increased from 3 hits of 100% damage (300%) to 3 hits of 200% damage (600%).
  • Rate was lowered from 20% to 10%.
The following changes were implemented to Blade of Destiny (50-80) on February 5th, 2021:
  • Special's damage was lowered from 3 hits of 200% damage (600%) to 3 hits of 75% damage (225%).
  • Activation rate was increased from 10% to 20%.
  • A 'Weaken' effect that applied -30 Light Resist to target for 5 turns inclusive was added.
A Level 90 version was released as a direct upgrade to Blade of Destiny (80) on June 3rd, 2022.
The following changes were implemented to Blade of Destiny (90) on July 8th, 2022:
  • Previously had the description: You have helped Ash complete his quest to become a Knight! The Blade of Destiny is yours.
  • An On-Hit special that applied 'Overwhelming Light' (-30 Light Resist) to target for 3 turns inclusive on a 7% chance was added.
  • On-Attack special's activation rate was modified from 20% to 7%.
The following changes were implemented to Blade of Destiny (50-90) on September 1st, 2023:
  • Level 90 version previously had the description: You have helped Ash complete his quest to become a Knight! The Blade of Destiny is yours. Has a chance on hit to reduce foe's Light resistance by 30 for 3 turns.
  • 'Weaken' effect was removed from its On-Attack Special.
  • Special's damage was increased from 3 hits of 75% damage (225%) to 3 hits of 100% damage (300%).
  • 'Overwhelming Light' was replaced by a Non-Crit/Crit Damage Reduction effect called 'Destiny's Light Guard'.
  • On-Hit special's activation rate was increased from 7% to 10%, which can also be increased to 20% if player attacks with the Light element.
  • On-Attack special's activation rate was increased from 7% to 20% for the Level 90 version.
On-Demand special's damage was reduced from 3 hits of 100% damage (300%) to 3 hits of 67% Light damage (201%) on September 8th, 2023.

weaponSpecial.trigger: Activate your weapon's special!
weaponSpecial.effect:
1 hit of 200% Bacon damage; applies 'Hammerbound Crush' (-40 Crit) to target for 6 turns; attempts to shrink the target (see other information).
  • If target was already shrunk, attack instead performs 1 hit of 400% Bacon damage, with +300 Crit. (Pop-up: Cysero's hammer crushes the already shrunken foe!)
weaponSpecial.notes:
The On-Demand special will attempt to shrink the target.
  • If successful, reduces both the target's max and current HP to 90% of their previous values, as well as physically reducing the target's size. (Pop-up: Cysero's hammer uses SHRINK on <target's name>!)
  • The target can resist the shrink through their Shrink Resist (inclusive of All Resist). (Pop-up: Cysero's hammer tries... but <target's name> resist!)
  • If the target has already been shrunken, its HP and size will not be reduced again, allowing the damage from the On-Demand special to increase.
The On-Demand special's damage is reduced to 300% max base damage before damage modifiers (Boost, Resists, etc.) are applied during Arena at the Edge of Time challenges.
Skill's appearance is randomized; it will randomize between a duck, a DragonCoin, and a hammer.

shared.description: Eight elemental orbs to celebrate DragonFable's anniversary! Visit the Black Market Moglin to upgrade this weapon. This weapon requires a Dragon Amulet.
shared.notes:
Weapons are animated; the red doom threads pulse and the wheels rotate continuously; weapons also have unique animations for each available element:
  • In all appearances, the Water Orb's water runs, the Energy Orb crackles with energy, and the Darkness Orb's purple markings rise continuously.
  • In Water appearance, the water on the dragon's head runs continuously.
  • In Ice appearance, the blade sparkles periodically.
  • In Wind appearance, the blade shimmers periodically.
  • In Fire appearance, flames flicker across the dragon's head and the blade continuously, and markings on the blade pulse continuously.
  • In Stone appearance, rocks float and spin near the blade continuously.
  • In Light appearance, the wing near the dragon's head flickers with yellow flames, and the blade emits orbs of light periodically.
  • In Energy appearance, the horn on the dragon's head and the blade crackle with energy continuously, and energy runs through the blade periodically.
  • In Darkness appearance, the blade emits skulls of darkness continuously, and the black doom threads on the dragon's head wiggle continuously.
Click on the weapon's orbs to change between its available elements; this will also change its appearance; weapons are animated between transitions, and the selected element's orb shimmers periodically. (Pop-up: <Element>!)

shared.description: Eight elemental orbs to celebrate DragonFable's anniversary! Visit the Black Market Moglin to upgrade this weapon.
shared.notes:
Weapons are animated; the red doom threads pulse and the wheels rotate continuously; weapons also have unique animations for each available element:
  • In all appearances, the Water Orb's water runs, the Energy Orb crackles with energy, and the Darkness Orb's purple markings rise continuously.
  • In Water appearance, the water on the dragon's head runs continuously.
  • In Ice appearance, the blade sparkles periodically.
  • In Wind appearance, the blade shimmers periodically.
  • In Fire appearance, flames flicker across the dragon's head and the blade continuously, and markings on the blade pulse continuously.
  • In Stone appearance, rocks float and spin near the blade continuously.
  • In Light appearance, the wing near the dragon's head flickers with yellow flames, and the blade emits orbs of light periodically.
  • In Energy appearance, the horn on the dragon's head and the blade crackle with energy continuously, and energy runs through the blade periodically.
  • In Darkness appearance, the blade emits skulls of darkness continuously, and the black doom threads on the dragon's head wiggle continuously.
Click on the weapon's orbs to change between its available elements; this will also change its appearance; weapons are animated between transitions, and the selected element's orb shimmers periodically. (Pop-up: <Element>!)

shared.description: This replica of the legendary Dragon Blade was crafted by Zee and enhanced by Ashendal! It will increase your BtH and Damage against Reptiles and Dragons! This item requires a Dragon Amulet.
shared.notes:
Weapons initially have a discounted price of 500, 800, 1,500, 3,000, 6,000, 8,000, 10,000, and 12,000 Gold, with a sellback value of 50, 80, 150, 300, 600, 800, 1,000, and 1,200 Gold respectively.
Weapons were tiered with Roman numerals on February 8th, 2025.
Reduced anti-Dragon and anti-Reptilian effects during Arena at the Edge of Time challenges were introduced on May 15th, 2026.

weaponSpecial.trigger: Your weapon special activates on hit.
weaponSpecial.effect:
Triggers on targets of 'Dragon' and 'Reptilian' race;
  • +5 Bonus and +10% damage on targets of 'Reptilian' race. (Rate: 100%)
    • During Arena at the Edge of Time challenges, damage bonus is reduced to +5%.
  • +10 Bonus and +15% damage on targets of 'Dragon' race. (Rate: 100%)
    • During Arena at the Edge of Time challenges, damage bonus is reduced to +10%.

shared.notes:
Weapons have Marketability flavor resistance.
Weapons are a reference to both the 'IKEA BL�HAJ Shark' and 'Don't Turn Me Into Marketable Plushies' memes.
Weapons are color-custom; the plushie is linked to the player's dragon skin color, and the eye is linked to the player's dragon eye color.
Click anywhere on the weapon to reposition it through a total of 3 different positions; this functionality was added on June 23rd, 2023.

shared.notes:
*Formula for temporary weapon damage:
  • quote:
Average damage formula: SQRT(Level)*10, rounded down; min/max damage values are generated randomly by subtracting/adding a value between 1 and 4 inclusive.
Weapons' special does not stack with Frozen Dagger, Frozen Mace, Frozen Wand, Glaive of Eternal Peace, High-Tech Turducken Carver, Hive Ranger's Halberd, Ice Scythe, or Vanilla Ice Katana's specials.
Weapons are animated; claymore pulses with a bright white glow continuously.
The following changes were implemented on April 22nd, 2020:
  • Special's -Ice Resist was modified from -100 Ice Resist to target for 49 turns inclusive to -30 Ice Resist to target for 5 turns inclusive.
  • Special's +Fire Resist was modified from +25 Fire Resist to player for 49 turns inclusive to +10 Fire Resist to player for 5 turns inclusive.
  • Special's damage was increased 100% damage to 200% damage.
  • Activation rate was increased from 5% to 20%.
Special's damage was increased from 200% to 300% on January 29th, 2021.

  • Special now requires to land its hit to activate its -Ice effect.
  • Resists' values were reduced from -30 Ice to -10 Ice Resist and +25 Fire to +10 Fire Resist respectively.
  • Damage was reduced from 300% to 200%.

shared.description: This blade focuses the power of nature itself through it! You can upgrade this weapon at the Black Market Moglin.
shared.notes:
Weapons cannot be destroyed.
Level 30-90 versions of this weapon have Mana flavor resistance.
Special effects, as per the August 4th, 2015 Design Notes:
  • quote:
If you have the Weapon equipped.
  • If the enemy race is "Plant" then it will weakness seek and increase all damage by 5%.
  • If the enemy race is "Fungus" then it will weakness seek and increase BtH by 10%.
  • If enemy resistance to Nature > 0 then it will weakness seek.
If you have either the Helm or Cape equipped, or both.
  • If the enemy race is "Beast" then it will weakness seek and increase BtH by 20%.
  • If the enemy race is "Bug" then it will weakness seek and increases chance of a Crit on hit by 5%.
  • If the enemy race is "Giantkind" then it will weakness seek and increase all damage by 6%.
If you have the Helm and Blade equipped.
  • Increases chance of a Crit on hit by 5%.
If you have the Cape and Blade equipped.
  • Increases BtH by 5%.
If you have the Helm and Cape and Blade equipped.
  • Increases chance of a Crit on hit by 8% and BtH by 10%
  • These stack to an effect as well. So if you have the Cape equipped to get the trigger bonus you not only get the +5% BtH but you also get the Beast, Bug, and Giantkind effects as well! The only exception to this is if the enemy has a resistance to Nature AND is one of the race types. The blade will pick the special based on the race of the monster before it attempts to use the Nature Resistance special. (Since the race specials are a lot stronger it makes sense not to have one of them overwritten!)
Nature Resist special initially included All Resist; this was changed to activate irrespective of All Resist on March 24th, 2021, then reverted on April 11th, 2021, requiring the weapon to be equipped for all weakness seeking effects.

shared.description: This replica of the legendary Ice Scythe was created by Ashendal. It is enchanted to occasionally lower your foes resistance to Ice! This item requires a Dragon Amulet.
shared.notes:
Weapons' special does not stack with Frozen Claymore, Frozen Dagger, Frozen Mace, Frozen Wand, Glaive of Eternal Peace, High-Tech Turducken Carver, Hive Ranger's Halberd, or Vanilla Ice Katana's specials.
Weapons initially have a discounted price of 500, 800, 1,500, 3,000, 6,000, 8,000, 10,000, and 12,000 Gold, with a sellback value of 50, 80, 150, 300, 600, 800, 1,000, and 1,200 Gold respectively.
The following changes were implemented on February 5th, 2021:
  • Special's duration was reduced from 5 turns to 3 turns.
  • Activation rate was increased from 5% to 10%.
Special's activation rate was reverted to 5% on February 13th, 2021, then increased to 7% on February 20th, 2021.
The following changes were implemented on September 1st, 2023:
  • Special's Resist value was lowered from -30 to -10 Ice Resist.
  • Activation rate was increased from 7% to 15%.
Weapons were tiered with Roman numerals on February 8th, 2025.
